definitions: To stay in bed for an extended period, often due to illness, depression, or a desire to avoid responsibilities.
To spend an excessive amount of time in bed, typically engaging in passive activities like sleeping, watching TV, or using electronic devices, rather than being productive or active.
examples: I just want to bed-rot all weekend.
She's been bed-rotting since she got sick.
He tends to bed-rot when he's feeling down.
